capabilities: Track remaining uses on a pass
Count down time left on the current pass
Calculate the latest start for the next pass
Show a countdown view in Bases
extras: Free, MIT-licensed, no network or account. One pass type per vault; in-app reminders only fire while Obsidian is open; phone reminders need re-exporting the .ics after new activations. Obsidian 1.8.7–1.9.x use older release 1.4.1.
intentEvidence: the older tracker it grew out of (povo-7day-tracker)
motivation: The author built it around a Japanese mobile data bundle of 52 uses of 7-day unlimited data, to be activated by 24 August 2027.
problem: Prepaid multi-use passes don't show how many uses remain or the last moment to activate them, so uses get wasted before the deadline.

relations.evidence: the older tracker it grew out of (povo-7day-tracker)

summary: Pass tracker that counts down uses and time on a multi-use pass with a deadline, showing pace and reminders before each pass ends.
